thread:
joel.a: FYI baseline benchmark-launch campaign pushed ~12k leads. noticed heavy owner skew and enrichment 429s. most traffic going to NA SDR cluster.

rita.s: seeing same. geo-weighted RR config shows emea_weight=0 for that campaign (whoops). that explains skew. but even after reweighting enrichment service is throttling -> claim queue backlog.

hubspot-bot: [ALERT] campaign=benchmark-launch enrichment_rate_limit=120r/m exceeded. pending_assignments=1120

harper.l: short-term: enable overflow_pool for campaign and route to shared-inbound-pool, reduce batch_size from 200 -> 50, and add exponential backoff on assign retries.

sam.r: agree. quick patch config snippet:
```json
{"campaign":"benchmark-launch","geo_weights":{"na":0.7,"emea":0.3},"overflow_pool":"shared-inbound-pool","batch_size":50}
```

rita.s: also increase webhook_timeout from 3s -> 8s for that campaign so partial enrichments don't break assignment. fast-path: if enrichment not returned in 8s, attach minimal profile (email+source) and route to overflow_pool. tradeoff: lower enrichment quality vs SLA.

hubspot-bot: action: applying canary to 5% traffic (tag: burst-overflow-canary).

growth-bot: notify: @sales @sdr-team - temporary overflow routing enabled, expect lead quality delta.

joel.a: sample webhook latency that failed:
POST /enrich
status: 429
body:{"lead":"L-77x","retry_after":30}

harper.l: long-term: add per-campaign concurrency caps, telemetry for owner-distribution, and deterministic sharding so allocator nodes don't race on retries. also include automatic campaign-burst flagging in console.

sam.r: short-term canary shows pending_assignments 1120 -> 140 after patch. rolling to 100% in 7m if stable.

rita.s: filing follow-ups: add rollback if noop_rate>1.5% and update runbook. :thumbsup:
